run_video_chunking: run the video chunking script to split Ego4D videos into 600-second segments using multiprocessing
run_video2segments: run video2segments to split a single video file into fixed-duration chunks using ffmpeg
refactor_video2segments: refactor video2segments to accept configurable duration limits and input output directory paths
review_video2segments: review video2segments for safe ffmpeg subprocess usage and proper OpenCV video capture cleanup
summarize_video_chunk: summarize the video chunking module that reads a manifest CSV and parallel-processes video splitting
